points.title: 早年求学
points.description: 蒲鲁东出生于法国贝桑松的一个贫苦家庭，父亲是酿酒工人。由于家境贫寒，他早年被迫中断学业，当过印刷工人和排字工。然而，他通过自学获得了广泛的知识，对哲学、政治经济学和历史产生了浓厚兴趣。1837年，他凭借一篇关于拉丁语诗歌的论文获得贝桑松学院的奖学金，得以重返校园。这一时期，他开始接触启蒙思想，尤其是卢梭和康德的著作，形成了自己独特的政治哲学观点。
points.descriptionEn: Proudhon was born into a poor family in Besançon, France, with his father working as a brewer. Due to financial hardship, he had to interrupt his education early and worked as a printer and typesetter. However, he acquired extensive knowledge through self-study, developing a keen interest in philosophy, political economy, and history. In 1837, he received a scholarship from the Besançon Academy based on an essay on Latin poetry, allowing him to return to formal education. During this period, he was exposed to Enlightenment ideas, particularly the works of Rousseau and Kant, which shaped his unique political philosophy.

points.title: 思想形成
points.description: 蒲鲁东移居巴黎，开始积极参与政治和思想活动。1840年，他发表了《什么是财产？》，在这部著作中他提出了著名的论断：'财产即盗窃'。这一观点使他一举成名，也使他成为当时激进思想界的重要人物。在巴黎期间，他深入研究了政治经济学，特别是亚当·斯密和李嘉图的著作，同时批判了资本主义和社会主义的弊端。他开始形成自己的无政府主义思想体系，主张建立一种基于自由和平等的互助社会。
points.descriptionEn: Proudhon moved to Paris and began actively engaging in political and intellectual activities. In 1840, he published 'What is Property?', in which he famously declared that 'property is theft.' This statement brought him immediate fame and established him as a significant figure in contemporary radical thought. During his time in Paris, he studied political economy, particularly the works of Adam Smith and David Ricardo, while critiquing the flaws of both capitalism and socialism. He began developing his own anarchist philosophy, advocating for a society based on mutualism, freedom, and equality.

points.title: 革命实践
points.description: 1848年法国二月革命爆发后，蒲鲁东积极参与政治活动。他创办了《人民之声》报，宣传他的政治理念。同年，他当选为国民议会议员，成为法国历史上第一位无政府主义者议员。在议会中，他反对中央集权，主张地方自治和联邦制。革命失败后，他因批评政府而被判处三年监禁。在狱中，他继续写作，完成了《革命和教会中的正义》等重要著作。这一时期，他的思想更加成熟，形成了完整的互助主义理论体系。
points.descriptionEn: Following the outbreak of the French February Revolution in 1848, Proudhon actively engaged in political activities. He founded the newspaper 'The Voice of the People' to promote his political ideas. In the same year, he was elected as a member of the National Assembly, becoming the first anarchist in French parliamentary history. In the Assembly, he opposed centralization, advocating for local autonomy and federalism. After the revolution's failure, he was sentenced to three years in prison for criticizing the government. During his imprisonment, he continued writing, completing important works such as 'Justice in the Revolution and in the Church.' This period saw his ideas mature into a comprehensive mutualist theory.

points.title: 理论完善
points.description: 蒲鲁东在这一时期完成了他最重要的著作之一《论联邦制》。他进一步完善了互助主义理论，提出了建立'自由联邦'的构想，主张通过自愿联合而非国家强制来实现社会合作。他还创办了'人民银行'，试图实践他的经济互助理念。1853年，他发表了《战争与和平》，批判国家主义和军国主义。这一时期，他的思想影响不断扩大，不仅在法国，在整个欧洲和北美都有追随者。他开始与马克思展开激烈辩论，反对马克思的共产主义理论，认为国家权力最终会导致新的压迫形式。
points.descriptionEn: During this period, Proudhon completed one of his most important works, 'On Federalism.' He further developed his mutualist theory, proposing the creation of a 'free federation' based on voluntary association rather than state coercion. He also established the 'People's Bank' to put his economic mutualism into practice. In 1853, he published 'War and Peace,' criticizing nationalism and militarism. His influence continued to expand during this time, with followers not only in France but throughout Europe and North America. He engaged in heated debates with Marx, opposing communist theory, arguing that state power would ultimately lead to new forms of oppression.

points.title: 晚年思想
points.description: 蒲鲁东晚年继续完善他的政治哲学，发表了《论艺术中的进步》和《论正义》等著作。他开始更加关注艺术和文化在社会变革中的作用，认为艺术是自由表达的重要形式。1863年，他当选为巴黎市政议员，试图通过地方政治实践他的理念。1865年，蒲鲁东因患天花在巴黎去世，享年56岁。他的去世标志着第一代无政府主义理论家的终结，但他的思想对后来的无政府主义运动产生了深远影响，成为现代无政府主义理论的重要基石。
points.descriptionEn: In his later years, Proudhon continued to refine his political philosophy, publishing works such as 'On the Progress in the Arts' and 'On Justice.' He began to pay more attention to the role of art and culture in social change, viewing art as an important form of free expression. In 1863, he was elected as a municipal councilor in Paris, attempting to practice his ideas through local politics. Proudhon died of smallpox in Paris in 1865 at the age of 56. His death marked the end of the first generation of anarchist theorists, but his ideas had a profound impact on later anarchist movements, becoming an important cornerstone of modern anarchist theory.

appraisal.zh: 蒲鲁东被视为无政府主义之父，其互助主义理论为自由意志社会主义奠定基础，他提出的自由联邦与人民银行构想，以及对国家权力的批判，使他成为激进民主思想的重要先驱，名言「财产即盗窃」更成为反资本主义的标志性口号。也有研究者指出，他的思想存在明显矛盾，既反对国家权力又主张某种经济干预，互助主义被指过于理想化；他在《论正义》中公开反对妇女选举权，反犹言论与对少数群体的歧视态度也使人品与思想受到质疑。学界因此视其为介于自由主义与社会主义之间的独特政治哲学传统。
appraisal.en: Proudhon is regarded as the father of anarchism: his mutualist theory laid the groundwork for libertarian socialism, his ideas of free federation and a people's bank, together with his critique of state power, made him a precursor of radical democratic thought, and "property is theft" became a hallmark slogan of anti-capitalist movements. Researchers also point to glaring contradictions—opposing state power while endorsing a form of economic intervention, an idealism blind to real power inequality; his open opposition to women's suffrage in "On Justice," his anti-Semitic remarks and discriminatory attitudes have raised questions about both character and doctrine. Scholarship thus places him in a distinctive tradition between liberalism and socialism.

supporter.zh: 蒲鲁东被誉为无政府主义之父，他的互助主义理论为后来的自由意志社会主义奠定了基础。支持者认为他是一位深刻的思想家，预见到了资本主义和集权社会主义的共同弊端。他提出的'自由联邦'构想和'人民银行'理念，为建立非压迫性的社会组织提供了宝贵思路。蒲鲁东对个人自由的坚定捍卫和对国家权力的批判，使他成为现代自由主义和激进民主思想的重要先驱。
supporter.en: Proudhon is hailed as the father of anarchism, and his mutualist theory laid the foundation for later libertarian socialism. Supporters view him as a profound thinker who anticipated the flaws of both capitalism and centralized socialism. His concepts of 'free federation' and the 'People's Bank' provided valuable ideas for building non-oppressive social organizations. Proudhon's steadfast defense of individual freedom and critique of state power make him an important precursor to modern liberal and radical democratic thought.

critic.zh: 批评者认为蒲鲁东的思想存在严重矛盾，他一方面反对国家权力，另一方面又支持某种形式的经济干预。他的互助主义理论被批评为过于理想化，忽视了现实中的权力不平等问题。蒲鲁东对女性的态度也备受争议，他在《论正义》中公开反对妇女选举权，认为女性不适合参与政治。此外，他的反犹言论和对某些少数群体的歧视态度，也使他的人品和思想受到质疑。
critic.en: Critics argue that Proudhon's ideas contain significant contradictions, as he opposed state power while supporting certain forms of economic intervention. His mutualist theory is criticized as overly idealistic, ignoring issues of real-world power inequality. Proudhon's attitude toward women is also controversial; he openly opposed women's suffrage in 'On Justice,' arguing that women were unsuited for political participation. Furthermore, his anti-Semitic remarks and discriminatory attitudes toward certain minority groups have led to questions about his character and ideology.

objective.zh: 在历史学界，蒲鲁东被视为19世纪欧洲激进思想的重要代表人物，其思想介于自由主义和社会主义之间。他的无政府主义理论影响了后来的巴枯宁、克鲁泡特金等无政府主义思想家，也对工团主义和自治主义产生了深远影响。在流行文化中，蒲鲁东常被描绘为反抗权威的象征，他的名言'财产即盗窃'成为反资本主义运动的标志性口号。然而，现代学者也认识到蒲鲁东思想的复杂性，既不完全属于传统左翼，也不属于右翼，而是代表了一种独特的政治哲学传统。
objective.en: In historical scholarship, Proudhon is regarded as an important representative of 19th-century European radical thought, with ideas situated between liberalism and socialism. His anarchist theory influenced later anarchist thinkers such as Bakunin and Kropotkin, and had a profound impact on syndicalism and autonomism. In popular culture, Proudhon is often depicted as a symbol of resistance to authority, and his famous quote 'property is theft' has become a标志性 slogan of anti-capitalist movements. However, modern scholars also recognize the complexity of Proudhon's thought, which doesn't fully belong to traditional left or right, but represents a unique political philosophical tradition.
